paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: Comparison of correlation between training loss (cross-entropy objective loss for Consistency-CE and Bi-objective loss for Consistency-Bi) and translation quality (BLEU score) on train subset of WMT15 De-En task for wait-k policy.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the correlation between training loss and translation quality for two different loss functions, Consistency-CE and Consistency-Bi, across varying testing k values. The x-axis, labeled "testing k", has a linear scale, ranges from 1 to 9, and has tick labels at intervals of 2. The y-axis, labeled "Correlation", also has a linear scale, spans from 0.5 to 0.95, and has tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The blue dashed line with circle markers represents Consistency-CE, starting at approximately 0.62 when testing k is 1, increasing to around 0.73 at testing k = 5, and then stabilizing at about 0.74 when testing k is 9. The orange solid line with square markers represents Consistency-Bi, beginning at around 0.95 when testing k is 1, rising to approximately 0.97 at testing k = 3, and remaining steady at this value for higher testing k values.
